translated_title: SESNSP Reports 52 Percent Reduction in Homicides; September Registers Lowest for That Month Since 2015
original_title: SESNSP reporta reducción de 52 por ciento en homicidios; septiembre registra mínimo para ese mes desde 2015
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: Homicides fell from 86.9 to 42.2 a day, yet seven states still account for nearly half of all killings, led by Baja California and Guanajuato.
